steps.title: Pick up 4 tips from slot 6
steps.instruction: Place the tip rack in slot 6 of the deck and use the pipette to pick up a fresh set of four disposable tips.

steps.title: Aspirate defined volumes from source set
steps.instruction: For the current set of four source columns, aspirate 20 µL from column 1, 2 µL from column 2, 2 µL from column 3, and 20 µL from column 4 of the two 96‑well deep‑well plates.

steps.title: Dispense into destination well and change tips
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated 20 µL, 2 µL, 2 µL, and 20 µL sequentially into the corresponding destination well of the 96‑well PCR plate, then discard the used tips.

steps.title: Process remaining wells in the set
steps.instruction: Pick up a new set of four tips and repeat the aspirate (step 2) and dispense (step 3) actions for the remaining four wells that lie beneath the eight already filled wells in both source and destination plates.

steps.title: Repeat for all column sets
steps.instruction: Iterate the entire sequence (steps 1‑4) for each group of four columns, i.e., one set per destination column, until the desired number of sets has been completed.
